title: Receipts
description: Major purchases and receipts for returns, warranty claims, and household expense tracking. Each receipt has a merchant, date, total, payment method, and item breakdown.

receipt_number.description: Receipt or invoice number, e.g. #2273, STE-042455-P42455

purchase_date.description: Date of purchase or receipt issue, ISO 8601

purchase_time.description: Time of purchase, HH:MM format if recorded

total_eur.description: Total amount paid, including tax, in euros

vat_eur.description: VAT amount if itemized, in euros

payment_method.description: How it was paid — card, cash, transfer

items.description: JSON string or text breakdown of line items — name, quantity, unit price, subtotal

customer_name.description: Name of the customer on the receipt if recorded

customer_afm.description: Tax identification number (AFM) if on the receipt

customer_phone.description: Customer phone if on the receipt

customer_address.description: Customer address if on the receipt

category.description: Purchase category — plumbing, home decor, electronics, etc.
